name: Jennifer Lo
title: Applied AI and analytics leader
summary: Applied AI and analytics leader with 7+ years of experience leading global enterprise AI adoption, analytics modernization, and automation. Experienced in identifying high-value AI opportunities, governing enterprise platforms, and delivering solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. A creative, adaptable and detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys learning, exploring new technologies, and communicating ideas.
